oids.name: cgmGdoiKSNewRegNotifEnable
oids.description: Indicates whether or not a notification should be generated on a Key Server when a new Group Member begins registration to a GDOI group.

oids.name: cgmGdoiKSRegCompNotifEnable
oids.description: Indicates whether or not a notification should be generated on a Key Server when a new Group Member successfully registers to a GDOI group.

oids.name: cgmGdoiKSRekeyPushNotifEnable
oids.description: Indicates whether or not a notification should be generated on a Key Server when a rekey is sent to a GDOI group.

oids.name: cgmGdoiKSNoRSANotifEnable
oids.description: Indicates whether or not an error notification should be generated on a Key Server when an RSA key is not set up.

oids.name: cgmGdoiGMRegNotifEnable
oids.description: Indicates whether or not a notification should be generated on a Group Member when it starts registration to a Key Server in a GDOI group.

oids.name: cgmGdoiGmRegCompNotifEnable
oids.description: Indicates whether or not a notification should be generated on a Group Member when it successfully registers to a Key Server in a GDOI group.

oids.name: cgmGdoiGmReRegNotifEnable
oids.description: Indicates whether or not a notification should be generated on a Group Member when it starts to re-register to a Key Server in a GDOI group.

oids.name: cgmGdoiGmRekeyRecNotifEnable
oids.description: Indicates whether or not a notification should be generated on a Group Member when it receives and processes a rekey sent by a Key Server in a GDOI group.

oids.name: cgmGdoiGmIncompCfgNotifEnable
oids.description: Indicates whether or not an error notification should be generated on a Group Member when there is missing information for configuring a GDOI group.

oids.name: cgmGdoiGmNoIpSecFlowsNotifEnable
oids.description: Indicates whether or not an error notification should be generated on a Group Member when no more security associations can be installed after receiving a rekey from a Key Server in a GDOI group.

oids.name: cgmGdoiGmRekeyFailNotifEnable
oids.description: Indicates whether or not an error notification should be generated on a Group Member when it is unable to successfully process and install a rekey.

oids.name: cgmGdoiKsRoleChangeNotifEnable
oids.description: Indicates whether or not cgmGdoiKeyServerRoleChange notification should be generated on a Key Server when its role changes from Primary to Secondary or vice-versa.

oids.name: cuspLastCounterResetTime
oids.description: This object gives the time stamp in date and time when the call counter was last reset. All counters related to calls, CPS and messages would be reset when counter is reset.

oids.name: cuspSystemState
oids.description: This object gives the CUSP system state. 'up' - System is up. 'down' - System is either offline or going down.

oids.name: cuspSystemUpTime
oids.description: This object gives the CUSP system up time information.

oids.name: cuspLicenseLimit
oids.description: This object gives the maximum licensed CPS limit value. Calls will be rejected if the license limit is exceeded.

oids.name: cuspLicenseState
oids.description: This object gives the current license state of the CUSP. 'waiting' - The initial state after an entitlement request while waiting for the authorization request response. 'overage' - The entitlement...

oids.name: cuspSmartAgentState
oids.description: This object gives the current license state of the Smart License Agent. 'unconfigured' - Smart licensing agent is not enabled and and all calls will be rejected in this state. 'unidentified' - Smar...

oids.name: cuspConfiguredMemory
oids.description: This object gives the total memory (RAM) in MB(MegaByte) configured on CUSP.

oids.name: cuspMemoryUsed
oids.description: This object gives the CUSP current memory (RAM) usage information in MB (MegaByte).

oids.name: cuspDiskSpaceUsed
oids.description: This object gives the current disk utilization of CUSP in MB (Mega Byte).

oids.name: cuspTotalCalls
oids.description: This object gives the total number of calls since the last counter reset.

oids.name: cuspTotalFailedCalls
oids.description: This object gives the total number of failed calls since last counter reset.

oids.name: cuspCPS
oids.description: This object gives the current running Calls Per Second (CPS) information.

oids.name: cuspAvgCPSOneMin
oids.description: This object gives the average CPS (Calls Per Second) in the last one minute.

oids.name: cuspMaxCPSOneMin
oids.description: This object gives the Maximum value of CPS (Calls Per Second) in the last one minute.

oids.name: cuspDroppedCallsOneSec
oids.description: This object gives the count on number of calls dropped in the last one second.

oids.name: cuspAvgDroppedCPSOneMin
oids.description: This object gives the average of 'dropped calls per second' in the last one minute.

oids.name: cuspMaxDroppedCPSOneMin
oids.description: This object gives the Maximum of 'dropped calls per second' in the last one minute.

oids.name: cuspCallsRoutedOneSec
oids.description: This object gives the number of calls routed through CUSP in last one second.

oids.name: cuspAvgCallsRoutedOneMin
oids.description: This object gives the average of 'calls routed per second' in last one minute.

oids.name: cuspMaxCallsRoutedOneMin
oids.description: This object gives the maximum of 'calls routed per second' in the last one minute.

oids.name: cuspCallsDroppedExceedingLicense
oids.description: This object gives the total calls dropped due to exceeding license limit.

oids.name: cuspStrayMessageCount
oids.description: This object gives the number of stray messages information. Stray messages are messages for which CUSP doesn't have a transaction.

oids.name: cuspNoOfMessagesRecieved
oids.description: This object gives the total number of messages received.

oids.name: cuspDiskSpaceThresholdValue
oids.description: The percentage threshold value configured by the user. If the percentage disk space utilization exceeds this limit then cuspDiskSpaceThresholdAlert notification is sent.

oids.name: cuspMemoryThresholdValue
oids.description: The percentage threshold value configured by the user. If the percentage memory utilization exceeds this limit then cuspMemoryThresholdAlert notification is sent.

oids.name: cuspServerGroupName
oids.description: This object gives the name of the server group.

oids.name: cuspServerGroupNetwork
oids.description: This object gives the network name to which the server group belongs.

oids.name: cuspServerGroupPingStatus
oids.description: This object gives server group ping status. true - Ping is enabled. false - Ping is disabled.

oids.name: cuspServerGroupLBType
oids.description: This object gives the load balancing algorithm for the server group. global - Uses global load balance algorithm. highestq - Uses highestq algorithm where in CUSP picks the first available element ...

oids.name: cuspElementName
oids.description: This object gives the Server group element ID.

oids.name: cuspElementStatus
oids.description: This object gives the server group element status. 'up' - Server group element is up. 'down' - Server group element is down.

oids.name: cuspElementQValue
oids.description: This object gives the Q value of the server group element. Q value is a real number that specifies the priority of the server group element with respect to others in the server group. Q value range...

oids.name: cuspElementWeight
oids.description: This object gives the weight of the server group element. Weight is used for load balancing between server group elements.

oids.name: cuspElementPort
oids.description: This object gives the port number of the server group element.

oids.name: cuspElementTransport
oids.description: This object gives the transport type of the server group element. Transport type can be udp,tcp or tls.

oids.name: cuspElementTotalCalls
oids.description: This object gives the total routed calls to the server group element.

oids.name: cuspElementFailedCalls
oids.description: This object gives the total failed calls on the server group element.
